links.comparator_used: ChatGPT prompted for a scientific reading level, with no simplification instruction
links.outcome: Reading grade level of ChatGPT-generated hand surgery patient education materials
links.effect: Mean reading grade level was 10th grade for ChatGPT at a 4th-grade prompt versus 14th grade for ChatGPT at a scientific level. Both exceeded the recommended 4th-6th grade by at least four grade levels.
links.tradeoff: The 4th-grade prompt did not reach the target level. The authors report that ChatGPT prompted for easier reading gave less robust information than patient-friendly websites, but this was measured against the websites, not against the scientific-level ChatGPT output.
links.quote: ChatGPT - 4th Grade Reading Level, ChatGPT - Scientific Reading Level, WebMD, and Mayo Clinic written materials on average exceeded recommended reading grade levels (4th-6th grade) by at least four grade levels (10th, 14th, 13th, and 11th grade, respectively).

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompting for patient education
